name: Sodomy
overview: The Scriptures reveal the grievous nature of the sin of Sodom, as God Himself declared the outcry of Sodom and Gomorrah to be great and their sin exceedingly serious. The narrative in Genesis 19 portrays the moral depravity of Sodom’s inhabitants, who sought to abuse the two angels visiting Lot, demanding to 'know' them in a manner that reveals their wicked intentions. Lot’s plea to the men not to act wickedly and his offer of his daughters instead underscores the severity of the situation and the protection he sought to provide. These passages emphasize the gravity of the sin associated with Sodom, highlighting the call for holiness and the consequences of such rebellion against God’s design.
